demo.title: breakra.sh
demo.code:
# Does this OpenAPI change break callers? ($0.02 USDC on Base via x402)
git clone https://github.com/danbuildss/breakra && cd breakra && bun install

# Pays once after checking the terms (exact, Base USDC, <= $0.02); errors are free
BREAKRA_KEY_FILE=./wallet.key bun examples/client.ts old.json new.json

# Real example: GitHub's REST API, Dec 2025 -> Oct 2026 (5 breaking, 35 potentially breaking)
BREAKRA_KEY_FILE=./wallet.key bun examples/client.ts demo/github-rest-api/before.json demo/github-rest-api/after.json

setup: No signup or API key: payment via x402 is the authorization ($0.02 USDC per analysis on Base)
Only a 200 is charged; invalid input, oversize specs and errors are free
Send two inline OpenAPI 3.0 JSON documents, before and after, up to 1 MB in total
Pay once per call: check the 402 terms (exact, eip155:8453, USDC, amount 20000) and never re-sign automatically
